description: Every Monday at 9am in the team's time zone (from setup), finds team members who haven't submitted this week's check-in and sends each one a WorkQ reminder with a link to the Weekly check-in form. Stays inside Workspace and sends nothing outside it.

flowIr.description: Every 15 minutes it checks the team's local time from setup; at the check-in time (Monday 9:00am by default) it reminds each team member who hasn't submitted this week's check-in, with the Weekly check-in form attached.
flowIr.name: Monday check-in nudge

outputs.description: Who was reminded, or why nobody was.
outputs.name: summary

nodes.summary: At the team's check-in time, sends each team member without a check-in this week a WorkQ reminder with the Weekly check-in form.
nodes.title: Remind people who haven't checked in

name: Monday check-in nudge
